Data Center Power Infrastructure
Power your hyperscale, colocation, or enterprise data center with transformers engineered for uptime. From utility entrance to rack-level distribution, Fluxco delivers complete solutions.Request Consultation
High Capacity
Transformers sized for hyperscale demands—from 500 kVA to 100+ MVA per unit.
Fast Deployment
Expedited sourcing and manufacturing through our global supply chain to hit aggressive schedules.
Redundancy Ready
N+1, 2N, and 2N+1 configurations with matched units for parallel operation.
Complete Solution
Full-service support from site assessment through commissioning and testing.
Transformer Solutions by Application
Every layer of data center power infrastructure requires different transformer specifications. We provide solutions for each stage.
Utility Service Entrance
Primary power delivery from utility grid to your facility. Medium voltage transformation with redundant feeds.
Substation transformersPad-mount transformers
Typical capacity: 10 MVA – 100+ MVA
UPS Input Transformers
Step-down transformers feeding UPS systems. K-factor rated for harmonic-rich loads.
Dry-type transformersK-rated transformers
Typical capacity: 500 kVA – 5 MVA
PDU Transformers
Distribution to power distribution units. Compact footprint for raised floor environments.
Dry-type transformersLow-voltage transformers
Typical capacity: 75 kVA – 1 MVA
Generator Output
Voltage matching between backup generators and facility distribution.
Dry-type transformersStep-up transformers
Typical capacity: 500 kVA – 10 MVA
